description: This source file defines the internal class 'ClientMessageCenter' in the Orleans.Messaging namespace. The class is responsible for managing client-side messaging connections, including establishing connections to gateways, managing message routing, and handling connection lifecycle events in an Orleans distributed application.

classes.name: ClientMessageCenter
classes.description: Handles client messaging, connection management, message dispatching, and gateway connectivity in Orleans cluster clients. Manages gateway connections, message routing, and connection lifecycle events, ensuring ordered or unordered message delivery to grains and system targets.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Establishes initial gateway connections and sets the messaging center to running state.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the message center and associated gateway connections.

methods.name: DispatchLocalMessage
methods.description: Dispatches messages locally using the registered message handler.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the appropriate gateway connection, handling connection establishment if needed.

methods.name: GetGatewayConnection
methods.description: Determines and retrieves the appropriate gateway connection for a message, considering target silo, grain, and routing rules.

methods.name: UpdateBucket
methods.description: Updates the bucket (weak reference) for a specific grain ID to manage ordered message delivery.

methods.name: RegisterLocalMessageHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler for processing incoming local messages.

methods.name: RejectMessage
methods.description: Rejects a message, logs the reason, and optionally sends a rejection response.

methods.name: OnGatewayConnectionOpen
methods.description: Handles logic when a gateway connection is successfully opened.

methods.name: OnGatewayConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles logic when a gateway connection is closed, including decrementing gateway count.
